438238.overview:
Fun with counting, colors, letters, drawing, and music!

Did It Myself ABC123 is a fun activity-toy-game-thing for young kids. It's packed with a bunch of different activities to stimulate your young child's brain, including:

• Counting
• Colors
• Letters
• Drawing
• Music

The target age range is about 2-3, but kids aged 1 through 5 should be able to enjoy Did It Myself ABC123. There are options for parents to adjust the counting range, the amount of games to play in "shuffle" mode, and the overall game speed. "Slow" and "medium" are recommended for younger kids, while older kids may enjoy "fast" and "ridiculous."

438241.overview:
Defend your base from attack until the reinforcements arrive!

Defend your base from attack until the reinforcements arrive! Take control of a mini arsenal of weapons and fight off wave after wave of enemy attack. Hold your base until the reinforcements arrive by flicking bullets and bombs at the oncoming enemies using the stylus. Arm your base with guns, cannons and tanks in preparation for the onslaught and then attack with everything you’ve got. Your mission is to survive... Good luck!

438312.overview:
Are you a Vampire Hunter? Are you ready to battle legions of undead foes including zombies, ghouls, werewolves and more? You will need to wield an arsenal of jaw-dropping powerful weaponry with skill and intelligence.

Uncover devastating firepower such as Machine Guns, Buzz-Saws and Flamethrowers, choosing upgrades for them as well as unique new perks for your character as your enemies increase in number and ferocity. You are a tough customer but beware - Lord Dracula is always on the hunt and you are his prey!

Enemies in Dracula - Undead Awakening have one thing in common. Undead, lycanthrope, mutant, and many more – they’re all after your flesh. Not to worry though – you come bearing “gifts”. Well, as long as you think of sharp, explosive, devastatingly destructive weaponry and ammo as “gifts”.

438387.overview:
They've attracted the attention of the local wildlife (the backyard is on the edge of a forest). To defend their treasure, the kids use all the materials at their disposal to create three types of robots: melee, sound and water bots. These bots act like a tower does in a tower defense game, keeping the enemy from the base. Each bot has certain strengths and weaknesses against different enemies. The enemies include bears, raccoons, rabbits, turtles and cats.

Play through 50 levels consisting of waves of animals - increasing in difficulty - who attempt to steal the candy. Should a creature reach the base, it will take a treat; this treat must be recovered or it will be lost. Should a boss reach the base, the game is lost. Successfully fend off the animals so the children can enjoy their end-of-summer feast.

438398.overview:
Adventure in the time of the dinosaurs. Save as many Dodo eggs as possible by leading them to safety.
DodoGo! Challenge, the sequel to the game DodoGo!, is a unique puzzle game which will put your intelligence to the test!

You must save as many endangered eggs as possible in nearly 100 dangerous, trap-infested levels! Use the stylus to dig in the terrain, set fire to objects, cut ropes and plenty of other mechanisms! Will you find the solution to bring all the eggs safely to their nest? Don’t worry, your perseverance will be rewarded with bonus levels and trophies which can be unlocked! Beat your own score and see how it ranks against the rest of the world!

438400.overview: For the first time on DSi, go all-in with EA’s Downtown Texas Hold ‘Em!Sharpen ‘n show off your poker skills in 2 exciting game modes and take on up to 20 players in authentic showdowns. Put on your best poker face and challenge friends to a Multiplayer match. Start with a practice game, play a round of classic poker, then jump into turbo tournament to win the grand prize! Buy your way into gambling halls & casinos, each with its own unique background with realistic tables, cards & chips!

438406.overview:
Can you outwit the puzzles at hand and receive gold awards all around! Remember, Don't Cross The Line!

"Don't Cross The Line is a puzzle game where the player must connect lines to various boxes, from one identical box to another, without crossing the lines they drew in the process. There are roughly 50 stages in all.

Depending on how quick you complete each stage, the player will be awarded with either a bronze, silver, or gold award."

438436.overview:
Double Bloob is a cartoonish, arcade-style vertical shooter.

The planet needs you! Bloobs have invaded the Earth and took a little dolphin named Will as a hostage! Don’t let the Bloobs win!

We all love arcade games. Double Bloob is one of those you immediately fall in love with. The simple story of two siblings – Aen and Niua – who, with some help of Doctor Maybe's inventions, try to set the little dolphin free is a just an excuse to have a great fun while shooting hordes of Bloobs that fly out in the sky. The colorful 2D graphics enhances the gameplay and draws the player more into the story and the game world. In order to keep the player entertained, the game contains tons of weapons and power-ups. Complete 8 different worlds and 48 levels to save Will from the evil Bloobs.

Are ready for the confrontation? Who is going to be the winner? You or the Bloobs? Prepare yourself for loads of fun and invite your friends to beat your high scores!

vertical shooter

action arcade game

cartoonish look

8 worlds, 48 levels

438441.overview:
Meet Walker. Walker is wandering the land of dreams, following his sleepy path amongst the clouds and stars. Guide Walker peacefully through Dreamland to Sunrise without him waking up. But be careful… Walker faces many challenges to a good night’s sleep! Alarm Clocks, Early Birds, and Night Mares thwart your efforts.

Dreamwalker is an action puzzler where you control the maze, shepherding Walker safely to his goal while counting sheep and avoiding sleep-disturbing hazards. Collect Reward Stars for clever solutions that complete the puzzle in minimal time or actions. Enjoy 40 levels of evolving challenges that introduce fresh puzzle features like disappearing rainclouds, disorienting spinners, teleporters and more!

Dreamwalker offers hours of game play, two bonus games, and a rich, evolving soundtrack. Appealing to casual and core gamers alike, it’s fun for all ages!

Features

• Manipulate Dreamland maze to shepherd Walker to safety
• 40 levels of evolving challenges, puzzles and hazards
• Includes collectibles, rewards, and bonus minigames
• Fun for all ages, whether you're casual or core gamer!

438464.overview: Doodle Fit, the best-selling puzzle game, is finally here! Your task is simple: fit the given sets of blocks into given shapes. Drag the blocks inside and outside in search for the layout that covers the whole shape. A level is complete when all blocks have been used and there's no more space free in the shape. The game features over one hundred different levels with a variety of unique shapes to play with. There are almost 550 solutions in total, which means you can enjoy near unlimited replayability.

447313.overview: Dive deep and explore the sea world to protect underwater wildlife. * Play as either Greg or Mila, both eager as ever to travel the world and save animals. * Explore 8 different submarine environments from the sunny Bahamas to the cold Arctic. * Approach over 50 different sea species to cure, nurture and collect valuable information about!

447540.overview: Nintendo DS Chinese character education software game released in Korea in 2009. This is a game that allows you to study Chinese characters by writing them directly using the touch screen, which is one of the features of Nintendo DS. Two years later, the sequel, Magic Cheonjamun DS 2, The Last Chinese Character Magic, was released.

463958.overview:
The DS de Blob is similar to the Wii game in terms of general gameplay and style. It was intended to be published by THQ and got a bit of promotion (even an empty GameFAQs page) alongside its console counterpart, only to be scrapped after Helixe abruptly shut down in the middle of development.

A build dated October 30, 2008 (just over a month after the Wii version's release) was released online on January 21, 2023.

465946.overview: Dekitayo Mama! Mitsugo no Kuma-san: Onna no Ko is an edutainment game for the Nintendo DS, developed and published by Starfish SD. Released in Japan on 15 April 2010, it is part of the broader Dekitayo! Mama (I Did It, Mum!) series aimed at young children.

472451.overview:
This is a hack of Dragon Quest IX made by RichterWilker that makes changes to the game to try and improve the experience.

These are:

* Music changes
* Quick message speed
* Infinite quick save
* 360 camera angle on town, world map and dungeons
* Run through enemies, touch them and press A to battle
* XP and Gold multiplier X2
* Press Select for max INN upgrade (impossible before without getting into contact with other players visiting your INN. Recommended after finishing the main story)
* Press Select+A+B for all DLC quests (only do this after quests 2, 117 and 120. Some quests are progressive, and you may get locked out of completing quests if activating DLC too soon.

472823.overview: Dictionary 6 in 1 with Camera Function is no ordinary dictionary; it transforms your Nintendo DSi into a unique language tool. Enter a word by hand, or simply snap a photo of it, to receive an instant translation.

472837.overview: Do you like to drive fast? Challenge authority?

472846.overview: This is your chance to become the dancing star you have always dreamed of becoming.

475056.overview:
Patch that contains the following quality-of-life changes for Digimon World Dawn:

* Increased text speed
* Increased player movement speed (by 1.5x)
* Reduced wild encounter rate (by 0.5x)
* Increased Scan Rate (from 15% base to 25%)
* Expanded Player Name Length (from 5 to 7 characters)
* Increased Exp Yield for Wild Digimon

480774.overview:
Help Dusty and his fearless fighters battle massive fires, and learn what it takes to become a true hero!

Battle fires and save lives in over 30 Fire & Rescue Missions!

Protect Piston Peak Park with eight playable characters including Dusty, Lil Dipper and Blade!
